# Kazakhstan Pharmaceutical Forum

> > Official site for the Kazakhstan Pharmaceutical Forum, a premier pharmaceutical and healthcare industry event held at Rixos Turkistan, April 16-17, 2026.

The forum brings together pharmaceutical leaders, healthcare professionals, and industry partners from Kazakhstan, Central Asia, and international markets to discuss pricing policy, pharma regulation, medical devices, and healthcare innovation. Organized in partnership with Global Pharmaceutical Leaders' Club and featuring key industry players including Bayer and Aretera Public Affairs.

## Key Topics

- Kazakhstan Pharmaceutical Forum
- Rixos Turkistan
- Central Asia healthcare
- Pharmaceutical pricing policy
